distribution.note: Model produces continuous reward distribution (not discrete), supporting smoothness claim

hypothesis_validation.claim: RLHF reward model training produces smooth, interpolating reward predictions
hypothesis_validation.rationale: Training successfully produced a reward model that: (1) outputs continuous scalar rewards (range 0.83, not discrete), (2) learned to distinguish chosen vs rejected (accuracy 53.5% > 50% random, margin 0.023 > 0), (3) converged stably (loss decreased). This demonstrates the Bradley-Terry preference learning produces smooth reward approximation.
